title: Chandan Sarbat
description: Chandan Sarbat (Sandalwood Syrup) is a premium medicinal syrup prepared from pure white Sandalwood (Santalum album) extract. This classical formulation provides instant relief from burning urination. Controls excessive sweating. Cools the brain.
dosage: 20–30 ml mixed into a glass of cool water, taken twice daily
